desc: Implement the lexicographic sorting plus adjacent LCP array plus sliding-window minima approach: sort words with original indices, compute adjacent LCPs, derive all k-window and (k+1)-window LCP values, combine global baseline with prefix/suffix maxima to answer each removal, and map results back to original order.
Explicitly handle edge cases in code: k = 1, n = k, n = k + 1, all words identical, one word being a prefix of another, and duplicate words with different original indices.
Run sample tests and targeted edge cases against the current implementation; report SAMPLE TESTS verdict and fix any failing case.
